lead_raw_text:
The tetragonal phase Er4Bi4Au8 (reduced formula ErBiAu2) crystallizes in space group I-4m2 (No. 119) with 16 atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies Au-centered 12-neighbor close-packed-like arrangements, Bi-centered 10-neighbor environments, and Er-centered 14-neighbor arrangements, with the periodic neighbor graph forming a single three-dimensional component. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner and face sharing between Au and Er polyhedra and between Au and Bi polyhedra, alongside edge sharing between Au and Bi polyhedra.
